package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow

class DoseLogRepository(private val doseLogDao: DoseLogDao) {
    fun observeRecentForProfile(profileId: Int): Flow<List<DoseLog>> =
        doseLogDao.observeRecentForProfile(profileId)

    fun observeMostRecentDose(profileId: Int, medicationId: Int): Flow<DoseLog?> =
        doseLogDao.observeMostRecentDose(profileId, medicationId)

    suspend fun getMostRecentDoseSnapshot(profileId: Int, medicationId: Int): DoseLog? =
        doseLogDao.getMostRecentDoseSnapshot(profileId, medicationId)

    suspend fun getPendingReminders(nowEpochMillis: Long): List<DoseLog> =
        doseLogDao.getPendingReminders(nowEpochMillis)

    suspend fun insert(doseLog: DoseLog): Long = doseLogDao.insert(doseLog)
}
